Start date: 2001-07-05  
Subtract 46 weeks: 46 × 7 = 322 days.  
Add 1 extra day to subtract: total 323 days before.  

2001-07-05 minus 323 days:  
July 5 → June 5 is 30 days (July 5 back to June 5) → 2001-06-05.  
From 2001-06-05, go back further: 323 − 30 = 293 days left.  
2001 is not a leap year (2000 was, 2001 isn't).  
From 2001-06-05 back to 2001-01-01: Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) = 151 days from Jan 1 to Jun 5.  
So from 2001-06-05 to 2000-12-31: 151 days earlier gets to Jan 1, need 293 − 151 = 142 days before 2001-01-01.  

2000 is leap year: Dec 31 minus 142 days:  
Dec (31) → Nov 30 (1 day) leaves 141, Nov (30) → Oct 31 (30 days) leaves 111, Oct (31) → Sep 30 (31 days) leaves 80, Sep (30) → Aug 31 (30 days) leaves 50, Aug (31) → Jul 31 (31 days) leaves 19.  
July 31 minus 19 days = July 12, 2000.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2000-07-12
